typeBlock.description: This type contains metadata used for correlating GDDI messages within the overall ground system.

tlv.description: Unique identifier for tracing the corresponding stacked GDDI type's data throughout a ground system flow. This 'Message Correlation' GDDI type does not carry a data payload because it is stacked with another GDDI type that carries the data payload, e.g. GDDI type 'Message Correlation' is stacked with GDDI type 'CCSDS MAP SDU' to provide this correlation ID for CCSDS command packets throughout the ground system. (Default: 0)
